rows: Scaffolding Diffusers in Maxtext-M3 (for Weaver) via WAN [4/4]
feat(ci): Skip heavy TPU/GPU CI on PRs with the auto-added `skip-ci-tests` label
[maxtext:attention_op] Support non-causal, sliding window and soft-cap in the GPU Tokamax (ragged) attention path.
Add Llama 3.1 8B GPU E2E test scripts (to_mt, pretrain, to_hf)
MoE: native FP8 QAT for routed-expert GMMs (FP8 forward + FP8-weight backward dLHS)
fix(vllm): use [gate | up] prefused MoE layout under expert parallelism
Fix Engram's n-gram hashing and ShortConv under context-parallel load balancing
m3: precision and quantization (qwix transform, matmul_precision)
Add an agent skill to facilitate usage of Goodput measurement
Keep the global batch size constant across elastic slice resizes.
ci: schedule the nightly and RC pipelines for the E2E TPU quota window
Fix `compile_xla_flags` being discarded before training step 0
Read logical axis names directly in from_pretrained checkpoint alignment
Remove internal run links from FSDP weight prefetching guide
feat(testing): add Qwen3-4B E2E pre-/post-training scripts
Migrate users of Pallas Triton FA kernel in Tokamax to the pure Triton variant
add GraniteMoe (granite-3.0-1b-a400m) model, conformance/TPU parity tests, and model-bringup-m3 skill
Fix two fp8 MoE training failures under JAX's HiJAX unreduced lowering.
Declare RLConfig.train_steps as a field and silence pylint E0203 false positive
Optimize FSDP prefetch under EP and support host-offloaded layer inputs
Fall back to pkgutil.get_data for custom_mesh_and_rule YAML in archives
Mask left-padding tokens before conv1d in Qwen3NextGatedDeltaNet
Add model-agnostic m3 CPU conformance spec, single-device training-engine Checks 1-4, and unit tests.
Fix the pipeline explicit-sharding tests on tpu7x
Share the single-axis stacking rule between the safetensors_dynamic loader and the converters
Update default Pathways container image paths in MaxText benchmarks to Louhi registry.
Original PR authors: Igor Tsvetkov (igorts), Wenxin Dong (wenxindongwork), Juan Acevedo (jfacevedo).
fix(testing): lower the HBM utilization of the Llama3.1-70B post-training vLLM decodes
fix(vllm): drop the restored NNX checkpoint tree in from_pretrained
Save Hy4Indexer top-k indices across rematerialization boundaries.
Add multi-device sharding and AOT HLO conformance Checks 5-8, unified runner, and synthetic unit tests for m3 models.
Fix the shared-expert gate under explicit sharding with tensor parallelism
Add standalone training entrypoint based on MaxTextTrainingEngine
Refactor MaxTextTrainingEngine state lifecycle, property setters, and single-pass state settlement

Add CPU conformance specs for qwen3-0.6b and glm5.3-flash, wire lazy dynamic spec discovery into conformance_test, and harden pure-array NNX transform boundaries and scanned Check 8 all-gather detection.
Migrate distillation launcher wrappers to Cluster Toolkit and mark XPK paths deprecated
Wire up chunked log-probability computation (`skip_lm_head` and `compute_final_logits`) in `TunixMaxTextAdapter`
extract float router logits across transformers >= 5.22 in granitemoe_test
Training engine: parameter freezing and optimizer mask refactoring
Add a Qwix multi-pass quantization to MaxText.
Adds GRPO ahead-of-time compilation and per-device HBM reporting for `MaxTextTrainingEngine`
